name: Rick's Causeway Coast Hostel
accommodation: Mix of rooms for backpackers, couples, families and small groups; most en suite
suitableFor: Solo travellers, couples, families and budget groups
confirmedFeatures: Kitchen, laundry, WiFi, TV and games room, linen hire, ground-floor bedrooms
overview: An independent hostel in a seafront terrace on Victoria Terrace in Portstewart, run by the same owner for over 20 years. It offers a mix of mostly en-suite rooms for backpackers, couples and families, with a guest kitchen, laundry, games room and on-site parking. Portstewart Strand is about 1.3 miles away, with Portrush's beaches a short drive east.
surfTripFit: A budget base with a kitchen, laundry and parking, well placed between Portstewart Strand and the Portrush breaks.
